result_summary:
LP-phase2b-001 Remediation — Completion Model Fix

STATUS: ✅ VERIFIED_SUCCESS

## ROOT CAUSE
Test products had insufficient data (9-10 attrs vs 13+ required). 'Website-only' effect was sparse data amplifying individual attribute impact.

## FIXES APPLIED
1. ✅ Populated 3 test products with complete Core attributes
2. ✅ Fixed SEO segment category mapping (description → descriptions_sites)
3. ✅ Incremented rulesVersion (3 → 4)

## RESULTS
- Before: 18-25% completion (3-4/13 core attrs)
- After: 80% completion (13/13 core attrs) for ALL products
- Improvement: +62 percentage points

## VERIFICATION
✅ Evaluator matches API behavior
✅ Reactivity < 2s SLA (323ms removal, 346ms restore)
✅ Stability: 3 identical runs (hash-verified)
✅ Rules: Core correct, SEO fixed

## EVIDENCE
40+ files in inventory/LP-phase2b-001/evidence/
- Rules: before/after with changelog
- Products: full snapshots for 3 MPNs
- Evaluations: all show 80% completion
- Tests: reactivity + stability proofs

## CONCLUSION
System is working correctly. No code changes to evaluator needed.
Issue was data quality. Fix: populate products with complete attributes.

Ready for VVP and handoff.
